title: Rise of the Eldrazi: card flavor text

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane overrun by the awakening Eldrazi, whose natural forces the Eldrazi reassert mastery over.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient titanic beings and their brood who awaken on Zendikar, whose hedrons coalesce into superstructures.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi ancient whose tentacles rummage through souls; he spawned a lineage.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi ancient with a hideous face, said to be hidden by the lie of Emeria.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi ancient whose lineage spreads death by death and who held nulls as slaves.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A being the Invokers once revered, later called a pleasant lie hiding Emrakul's face.

entities.name: Ula
entities.description: A being once thought divine, later called a cruel trick and grave error.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: A being once thought divine, later called a cruel trick and grave error.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Ancient stone structures that awoke with the Eldrazi and coalesced into superstructures.

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: A figure who left a whisper of perseverance in the Angelheart Vial.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who says invincible is just a word.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who prefers learning from others' failures.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who says morality is shorthand for powerlessness.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker who has gathered grudges for centuries, awaiting perfect vengeance.

entities.name: Tuktuk the Explorer
entities.description: A goblin remade by Eldrazi magic who inspired a clan of misguided goblins.

entities.name: Mandli
entities.description: An old priest who grabbed an axe and ran screaming into the hills.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: A slave-lord whose cleaver and cruelty were adopted by another.

entities.name: Javad Nasrin
entities.description: An Ondu relic hunter.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: A Kamsa cleric who lost faith in a beautiful god.

entities.name: Nirthu
entities.description: A lone missionary touring Eldrazi-stricken outposts.

entities.name: Zahr Gada
entities.description: A Halimar expedition leader.

entities.name: Ravuel of Graypelt
entities.description: A fighter who wishes to do his part against the Ancient Ones.

entities.name: Tars Olan
entities.description: A kor world-gift.

entities.name: Tala Vertan
entities.description: A Makindi shieldmate who rallies a line against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Zilan
entities.description: A Makindi auramancer.

entities.name: Trinda
entities.description: A Hada spy patrol member.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Tazeem lullmage.

entities.name: Maizah Shere
entities.description: A Tazeem lullmage.

entities.name: Jaby
entities.description: A Silundi Sea nomad.

entities.name: Mzali
entities.description: A Lighthouse archmage.

entities.name: Traga
entities.description: A Zulaport runner.

entities.name: Sheyda
entities.description: An Ondu gamekeeper who compares the Eldrazi killing mortals to farmers killing insects.

entities.name: Chadir the Navigator
entities.description: A guide who warns of dangers in Akoum.

entities.name: Yannash
entities.description: An outpost builder who builds no sanctuaries.

entities.name: Samila
entities.description: A Murasa Expeditionary House member.

entities.name: Sachir
entities.description: An Akoum Expeditionary House member.

entities.name: Nundari
entities.description: A Sea Gate militia captain.

entities.name: Jaji
entities.description: A magmaw worshipper.

entities.name: Moruul
entities.description: A Khalni druid who speaks of an old debt to collect.

entities.name: Sutina
entities.description: The Speaker of the Tajuru.

entities.name: Saidah
entities.description: A Joraga hunter.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: Elves led by a Speaker who say the trees will not remain bystanders.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: Elves who grant trolls their combined strength to drive them off.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people who track hartebeests for magic and tie their righteous dead to the land.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Vampire families, some of whom offered humans' blood to stave off the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Makindi
entities.description: A people with trenches, griffins, shieldmates and auramancers on Zendikar.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: A city that fell silent as the Eldrazi awoke.

entities.name: Howling Spire
entities.description: A place whose winds ceased as the Eldrazi awoke.

entities.name: Na Plateau
entities.description: A plateau declared lost.

entities.name: Helix of Zof
entities.description: An Eldrazi ruin haunted by a Zof Shade.

entities.name: Affa
entities.description: A once welcoming hub for explorers that became guarded.

entities.name: Tal Terig
entities.description: The site of ruins scholars puzzled over for centuries.

entities.name: Crypt of Agadeem
entities.description: The site of an inscription about the least of gods towering over mortals.

entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: A region where storms spread as the Eldrazi awoke.

events.summary: The hedrons coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures, forcing the griffins to seek new territory.
events.quote: As the hedrons began to coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures

events.summary: The Singing City falls silent and the winds of the Howling Spire cease.
events.quote: The Singing City was silent, the pathway stones were still, and the winds of the Howling Spire ceased.

events.summary: The Na Plateau is lost to the Eldrazi, as Nirthu warns.
Ulamog's tentacles rummage through a victim's soul and sting his memories one by one.
events.quote: Ulamog's tentacles, their touch like burning ice, rummaged through his soul

events.summary: The old priest Mandli suddenly grabs an axe and runs screaming into the hills.
events.quote: the old priest Mandli suddenly grabbed an axe and ran screaming into the hills

events.summary: Tuktuk is remade by Eldrazi magic and inspires a clan of goblins.
events.quote: Remade by Eldrazi magic, Tuktuk inspired an entire clan of misguided goblins.

events.summary: Kozilek's lineage spreads death by death.
events.quote: Death by death, Kozilek's lineage spread.

relations.note: Emeria is called a lie hiding Emrakul's face.
relations.quote: Emeria is a pleasant lie, a figment to hide Emrakul's hideous face.
